title: What If Earth Passed Through a Comet's Poison Tail?

scenes.text: What if Earth flew through a comet's poisonous tail? In 1910, it did.
In February 1910, astronomers reported cyanogen, a gas related to cyanide, in Halley's Comet tail.
Headlines warned the tail could snuff out all life. Some farmers refused to plant crops.
Sellers pushed comet pills, and one broker sold comet insurance. At least fifty people paid.
Mid-May 1910, Earth passed through the tail. The gas was so thin that effects were almost certainly nil.
Nothing happened. The only thing that changed was how much money people spent on fear.

description:
What if Earth passed through a comet's poisonous tail?
It did, in May 1910. Halley's Comet carried cyanogen, but the tail was so sparse that nothing happened, while panic sold comet pills.
